title: Majestic 12 / MAJI named in an NRO document

tellings.quote: Oh, it used to be called Majestic 12. The last I know it's been the last good name I can pinpoint on a document from the 90s from the NRO national reconnaissance office was uh magic

plain: A UFO researcher named Steven Greer says the secret group that handles UFO matters used to be called Majestic 12, and that the last name he can pin down for it is "Maji" or "Magic", taken from a 1990s document of the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites. Greer summarises this himself and does not show the document. If true, it would mean a hidden UFO group still existed under a new name decades later.
